bio: Hello! My name is Jacob Friedman, and I’m a first-year from New Smyrna Beach, Florida. I currently live in Canaday Hall, and am concentrating in either Molecular and Cellular Biology or Integrative Biology with a secondary in Environmental Science and Public Policy. As I’m passionate about languages, I may also pursue a citation in Mandarin. Some other organizations I’m part of include Phillips Brooks House Association (Environmental Action Committee on top!), the Harvard Undergraduate Research Association, and HUFPI. Outside of these, you may find me working on my psets in Lamont or Cabot, jamming to my Spotify playlists, or practicing Chinese. Thrilled to help plan fun events for our class while fostering a welcoming environment for all—feel free to say hello or reach out!
